name: Aidirs

sources.title: Homepage — active curated AI tools directory (2,400+ tools) with Submit and Pricing nav
Submit page — rendered only hero stats to the fetcher; real options shown on /pricing
Pricing — Free ($0, badge verification) through Sitewide ($79.9) plan comparison

conditions: Free $0 tier requires badge verification — their badge/backlink must be placed on your site
Free listings get 'recurring status checks' — the badge is monitored and removing it risks delisting
Free tier is queued review (no stated turnaround) vs 48h/24h for paid tiers; 'low-quality submissions rejected'
requirements: AI-focused product — this is a curated AI tools directory
Badge verification for the free tier; paid tiers ($9.9 Starter, $24.9 Pro, $49.9 Launch Kit, $59.9+ sponsor tiers) skip it
Quality bar applies at every tier; Stripe handles payments
preparation: Product name, URL, description, logo/icon, pricing model
For free tier: ability to add their badge HTML to the product site and leave it there
workflow: Open https://aidirs.best/submit (sign-in may be required — Sign In link is in nav)
Choose a plan: Free (badge + queued review) or a paid tier (48h/24h review, featured placement)
Fill the submission form with product details
Free tier: add badge to the site and pass verification; paid: complete Stripe checkout
Listing goes live after review; monitor via account
watchFor: Free tier's badge is monitored with 'recurring status checks' — it's an ongoing obligation, not one-time
Only the free tier explicitly promises 'one dofollow backlink'; paid tiers sell visibility, not more links
Sidebar/Sitewide sponsor tiers showed '0 slots available' — don't expect them
Launch Kit bundles 'Uneed launch support' — third-party cross-sell
countsAsLive: The product has a public profile page on aidirs.best, indexed in its categories/tags/search
unknowns: Queued-review turnaround for the free tier
Whether free-tier listings get a full SEO product page (comparison table marks it as paid-only)
